note: Ps40 thanksgiving->lament (corrected method). Human IB: qavah wait, tehillah new-song, chaphets delight-to-do-will (law in lev heart), unrestrained proclamation (kala-not/lev), lament (ra evils, avon iniquities, lev fails), foes/seekers, ani/evyon poor. ~20 God-attributes (tsedaqah/emunah/teshuah/chesed/emeth/racham + God's acts) = QUALIFIERS source-linked (the content proclaimed / the love that preserves). Every candidate roled.

dims.v: answered by God inclining and hearing

'I WAITED patiently (qavah) for the LORD; he inclined to me and heard my cry' — the patient expectant waiting rewarded; qavah (recurs Ps37,39) doubled here for intensity, the waiting that God answers by drawing him from the pit
a new song in the mouth

'He put a new song in my mouth, a song of PRAISE (tehillah) to our God' — the fresh praise of the rescued; tehillah the new song that makes many see and fear and trust — deliverance overflowing into evangelistic worship
'Many will see and FEAR (yare), and put their trust in the LORD' — the reverence David's testimony awakens in others; yare here the response of the many to his new song, fear leading to trust

'and put their TRUST (batach) in the LORD' — the trust born of witnessing God's deliverance of another; batach the reliance the testimony produces, faith spreading from the rescued to the watching many
the man who trusts the LORD
'BLESSED (esher) is the man who makes the LORD his trust' — the beatitude of the truster; esher (recurs Ps1,32,34) the happiness of the one whose confidence is God, not the proud or the liars
contrasted with turning to the proud
'who makes the LORD his TRUST (mibtach)' — God as the object of confidence; mibtach (the noun) the settled reliance that defines the blessed, set against the proud and the followers of lies
avoided ('does NOT turn to the proud')

'who does not turn to the PROUD (rahab), to those who go astray after a lie' — the arrogant the blessed man refuses; rahab = insolent pride, the false refuge the truster turns from to make the LORD his trust
delight in (chaphets - to do your will)
met by God's not-delighting in mere sacrifice (v6)

'I DELIGHT (chaphets) to do your will, O my God; your law is within my heart' — the heart of true obedience: not ritual but delighted willing conformity; chaphets the inner pleasure in God's will, the law internalised (contrast God's non-delight in mere sacrifice, v6; cited Heb10:7)
negated ('I have NOT restrained my lips')

'I have told the glad news of deliverance... I have not RESTRAINED (kala) my lips' — open, unstinting proclamation; kala negated, the refusal to hold back testimony to God's righteousness (its content, tsedeq, is the qualifier) — the mouth God opened (v6) now unmuzzled for praise
the deliverance/faithfulness not concealed but spoken

'I have not hidden your deliverance within my HEART (lev); I have spoken of your faithfulness and salvation' — the heart that refuses to conceal God's goodness; lev here the seat from which testimony flows outward, God's covenant attributes (tsedaqah/emunah/teshuah/chesed/emeth = the qualifiers) proclaimed not buried

'For EVILS (ra) have encompassed me beyond number' — the sudden turn from thanksgiving to distress; ra here the innumerable troubles that surround, hemming in the one who just praised — deliverance and distress held together
more than the hairs of his head

'my INIQUITIES (avon) have overtaken me... more than the hairs of my head' — guilt as a pursuer that catches him; avon (recurs Ps38,39) the sins so numerous they blind him ('I cannot see') and fail his heart
'my heart (lev) fails me' — the inmost seat giving way under guilt and trouble; lev here the courage/vitality that forsakes David (contrast v10's lev that proclaimed) — the same heart now sinking
'my heart FAILS (azab) me' — vitality/courage abandoning him; azab (recurs Ps38:10 of strength) here of the heart deserting David under the weight of his iniquities
'Let those be put to SHAME (bosh)... who seek to snatch away my life' — shame invoked on the life-seekers; bosh (recurs Ps35:4) the disgrace prayed on the foes who delight in his hurt
'and DISAPPOINTED (chaper) altogether' — abashment invoked with shame; chaper (recurs Ps35) the frustration prayed on those who seek David's ruin
'who seek to snatch away my LIFE (nefesh)' — the life the foes hunt; nefesh (recurs Ps35,38) the life-self targeted, whose seekers David prays be shamed
'let those be turned back and brought to DISHONOUR (kalam) who delight in my hurt' — humiliation invoked on those glad at his harm; kalam (recurs Ps35:4) the disgrace prayed on the hurt-delighters

'who DELIGHT (chaphets) in my hurt' — the foes' malicious pleasure; chaphets (same word as David's holy delight in God's will, v8) darkly inverted — delight in another's harm, the same faculty turned to evil
the object of the foes' delight
'who delight in my HURT (ra)' — the harm the foes relish; ra here David's injury, the object of the enemies' perverse joy
'Let those be appalled because of their SHAME (bosheth) who say, Aha, Aha!' — the mockers' own shame recoiling on them; bosheth the disgrace that appals the scoffers who taunted David
who then rejoice and are glad

'may all who SEEK (baqash) you rejoice and be glad in you' — the God-seekers set against the life-seekers (v14); baqash here the earnest pursuit of God, rewarded with joy, the antithesis of the foes seeking David's life

'may all who seek you REJOICE (sus) and be glad in you' — the joy of the God-seekers; sus (recurs Ps35:9) the exultation whose object is God himself, the proper joy contrasted with the foes' delight in hurt (v14)
'and be GLAD (samach) in you' — gladness in God; samach paired with sus, the joy of the seekers whose delight is the LORD

'may those who LOVE (aheb) your salvation say continually, Great is the LORD!' — love directed to God's saving work; aheb (recurs Ps31:23) the affection for God's salvation that overflows in continual praise
sustained by God's mercy/steadfast love (v11) and thought (v17)

'As for me, I am POOR (ani) and needy, but the LORD takes thought for me' — the humble self-estimate that rests in God's care; ani (recurs Ps34,35,37) the afflicted David, sustained not by his own resources but by God's mercy, chesed and mindful thought (v11,17 = the qualifiers)
'I am poor and NEEDY (evyon)' — the destitution David owns; evyon (recurs Ps35:10, 37:14) the beggar-poverty of the sufferer whom God nonetheless regards as his help and deliverer
v1: 'I WAITED PATIENTLY (qavvoh qivviti)' - the infinitive-absolute doubling that intensifies the waiting (278212); qualifier (emphatic manner) of the wait.
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'he inclined to me and HEARD (shama) my cry' - God's hearing is not a human IB char; it is the answer to David's waiting (278212). Qualifier.
v5 QUALIFIER (God's deeds): 'you have multiplied your WONDROUS deeds (pala)... none can compare' - God's works are not a human IB char; they are the content of David's praise (278319). Qualifier.
God's purposes David marvels at / proclaims
v5 QUALIFIER (God's thoughts): 'your THOUGHTS (machashabah) toward us' - God's purposes are not a human IB char; the object of David's wonder and praise (278319). Qualifier.
delight in (chaphets - God's, in sacrifice, negated)
God's non-delight in sacrifice grounds David's delight to obey (v6->v8)

v6 QUALIFIER (God's disposition): 'In sacrifice you have not DELIGHTED (chaphets)... you have given me an open ear' - God's (non-)delight is not a human IB char; it grounds David's own delight to do God's will (278372, v8). Qualifier.
the object David delights to do (v8)
v8 QUALIFIER (God's will): 'I delight to do your WILL (ratson)' - God's will is not a human IB char; it is the TARGET/object of David's delight (278372). Qualifier.
the content of David's unrestrained proclamation (v9)

v9 QUALIFIER (God's righteousness): 'I have told the glad news of DELIVERANCE (tsedeq)' - God's saving righteousness is not a human IB char; it is the content David proclaims with unrestrained lips (278386). Qualifier.

v9 QUALIFIER (God's knowledge): 'I have not restrained my lips, as you KNOW (yada), O LORD' - God's knowing is not a human IB char; it is the divine witness David appeals to for his open testimony (278386). Qualifier.
not hidden in David's heart but proclaimed (v10)

v10 QUALIFIER (God's righteousness): 'I have not hidden your DELIVERANCE (tsedaqah) within my heart' - God's righteousness is not a human IB char; it is what David refuses to conceal in his heart (278224). Qualifier.
v10 QUALIFIER (God's faithfulness): 'I have spoken of your FAITHFULNESS (emunah)' - God's faithfulness is not a human IB char; it is the content proclaimed from David's heart (278224). Qualifier.
v10 QUALIFIER (God's salvation): 'and your SALVATION (teshuah)' - God's salvation is not a human IB char; content proclaimed from David's heart (278224). Qualifier.
v10 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'I have not concealed your STEADFAST LOVE (chesed)' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; content David refuses to hide (278224). Qualifier.
v10 QUALIFIER (God's truth): 'your steadfast love and your FAITHFULNESS (emeth) from the great congregation' - God's faithfulness is not a human IB char; content proclaimed (278224). Qualifier.
God's not-withholding mercy preserves the poor David (v11->v17)
v11 QUALIFIER (God's act, negated): 'you will not RESTRAIN (kala) your mercy from me' - God's not-withholding is not a human IB char; it grounds David's preservation (278295, v17). Qualifier.
v11 QUALIFIER (God's mercy): 'you will not restrain your MERCY (racham) from me' - God's compassion is not a human IB char; the source preserving David (278295). Qualifier.
v11 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'your STEADFAST LOVE (chesed)... will ever preserve me' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the source of David's preservation (278295). Qualifier.

v11 QUALIFIER (God's faithfulness): 'your steadfast love and your FAITHFULNESS (emeth) will ever preserve me' - God's faithfulness is not a human IB char; the source of David's preservation (278295). Qualifier.
God's willingness sought to deliver the poor David (v13->v17)
v13 QUALIFIER (God's willingness): 'Be PLEASED (ratsah), O LORD, to deliver me!' - God's favour/willingness is not a human IB char; the source David appeals to for rescue (278295). Qualifier.
the rescue sought for the poor David (v13->v17)
v13 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'be pleased to DELIVER (natsal) me! make haste to help me!' - God's delivering is not a human IB char; the rescue David appeals for (278295). Qualifier.
v16 QUALIFIER (God's salvation): 'those who love your SALVATION (teshuah)' - God's salvation is not a human IB char; it is the object of the seekers' love (278288). Qualifier.
think of / regard (chashab - God takes thought)
God's mindful regard sustains the poor David (v17)

v17 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'but the LORD takes THOUGHT (chashab) for me' - God's mindful regard is not a human IB char; it is the source sustaining the poor and needy David (278295) - the whole psalm's resting-point. Qualifier.

v6: 'Burnt offering and SIN OFFERING (chattaah) you have not required' - a sacrificial category, not an inner operation; part of the ritual-vs-obedience contrast that grounds David's delight to do God's will (v8). Standalone.
lie / falsehood (kazab - go astray after a lie)

v4: 'those who go astray after a LIE (kazab)' - the falsehood the proud pursue; the false object of misplaced trust, qualifying the proud (278335) the blessed man refuses. Standalone/qualifier of the proud.
v1: 'he heard my CRY (shav'ah)' - David's cry that God heard; the vocal appeal of the waiting one, closely tied to the waiting (278212). Standalone (the IB movement is the waiting itself).
seek (baqash - seek to snatch my life)

v14: 'those who SEEK (baqash) to snatch away my life' - the foes' murderous pursuit; the seeking that targets David's nefesh (278271). Standalone/qualifier of the life-seekers (the IB finding is life 278271 + the shame invoked).
be great / magnified (gadal - Great is the LORD)
v16: 'say continually, GREAT (gadal) is the LORD!' - the acclamation of God's greatness the seekers speak; a confession of God's magnitude (God's attribute), not a human inner operation. Standalone.
